runs.name: Lianhe Sowell International Group Ltd
runs.box: TOO HARD (NATURE) AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$0.47** (close 2026-10-12, `tools/run.py` live quote, aggregator, flagged). Shares **13,493,666** (10,906,166 Class A and 2,587,500 Class B after the September 2026 unit offering, from the 424B4 of 2026-09-03, acc 0001213900-26-096975; the 20-F cover of 3,250,000 Class A and 62,500 Class B restated for the 1-for-16 consolidation of 2026-06-22 is earlier than the June Class B subscription and the offering; classes added for economic interest on the 13D/A's charter note; 22,916,667 offering warrants at $1.66 out of the money, not counted); cap **$6.34M**. Earnings currency RMB (20-F Item 5.B and Note 3), reported in USD; `tools/run.py` named USD and its 5.60% was not used. Sovereign **2.07%** (RMB; PRC Ministry of Finance China Treasury yield curve, compiled by ChinaBond, 30-year, 2026-10-12); conversion 6.7298 RMB per USD (CFETS central parity, 2026-10-13). Filings read: 20-F FY2026 (filed 2026-08-13, acc 0001213900-26-089090), 20-F FY2025 (0001213900-25-077169), the IPO 424B4 of 2025-04-04 (0001213900-25-028729), the first F-1 of 2024-05-10 (0001213900-24-041530), the F-1, F-1/A and 424B4 of August and September 2026, the 6-Ks, the 13D and 13D/A and Forms 3 and 4. Five balance sheets exist (March 2022 to 2026; private before the 2025 listing). Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 20-F's Items 4, 3.D and 5, as the overnight brief directs. Competitors: the 20-F names none; the September 2026 prospectus names nine (JT Automation, Suzhou TZTEK, SenseTime, Hanwang, Wisesoft, Beijing Qianfang, PCI Technology, Huawei, Inspur), none an SEC filer; none compared, flagged. **Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE)**: a PRC machine-vision products and solutions provider operating through Shenzhen Sowell; the filer's own words are "rapid iteration of technology and products" (Item 4.B) and "no significant barriers to entry" (Item 3.D); over the five years filed the revenue mix swung from 86% electronic products to 60% and back to 71%, software gross margin fell from 83% to 49% to 45%, two of the five largest customers carried over into FY2025 and none into FY2026, and three robot and car-service products were added since 2022; NATURE, not WORK: no unread filing supplies a ten-year forecast. Q2 to Q12 not reached; no research pass. After the stop, recorded not weighed: sales $0.95M (FY2022), $13.07M (FY2023), $36.6M (FY2024), forty-fold in two years before the listing; net receivables 35% to 71% of sales, allowance rising to $3.97M; prepayments $0.26M to $18.57M, of which $12.17M prepaid R&D consulting fees against an R&D staff of ten; cash under $0.8M at every year-end until the IPO; borrowings $7.07M, mostly one-year bank loans guaranteed by a shareholder; Note 2 headed GOING CONCERN; 2,400,000 post-consolidation Class B sold on 2026-06-30 to the chief executive's wholly owned company at $0.165 a share while the company's own 6-K of 2026-07-08 put the Class A bid at $1.00 or more from June 22 to July 6, the chief executive's vote rising to 97.69%; the 20-F describes that price differently ("75 % of the ... pre-consolidation closing price") from the 6-K, the 13D/A and the prospectus; $1.37M owed by the chief executive, interest-free, repayable on demand; the auditor WWC, P.C. dismissed 2026-03-14; the September units priced at $1.44 against a stated last sale of $2.88, the stock then $4.50 to $0.48 in a week (aggregator, flagged); integrity facts recorded, not judged. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash (operating cash less stock pay less all capital spending, from the filed statements) +$0.18M, -$1.47M, -$2.15M, -$1.51M, -$10.36M for FY2022 to FY2026, average -$3.06M a year (about RMB -20.6M); range **-$10.61 a share** (RMB -71.40), the no-growth case alone, the series changing sign, against $0.47, literal three-year window -$16.38 beside; floor tested first: no positive price earns it on any case; fair price beneath the stop **-$1.92 all-equity**, -$2.27 equity-only; not armed (box not OUT at Q7, and no positive figure). Contamination declared by the analyst: session-context commit subjects naming the LZ run and its fold, untracked research-folder names for AYI and ARCB, and the memory index's queue-state lines; none opened or used. Commits 1885f516, 08077842, e97014b5 (Step 0 committed with Q1, recorded in the self-audit). Citations: the analyst's check PASS (25 ids, 0 problems); the dispatcher's script (`dispatcher_quote_check2.py`) 19 quotations beside ids, every one in its row, 0 slips. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) the protocol's sovereign table covers USD, JPY and EUR only, and `tools/run.py` takes the earnings currency from the XBRL unit, which names USD for a 20-F filer reporting in USD with an RMB functional currency; (2) Q7's net-debt rule ("the latest filed balance-sheet date with the subsequent events that filing itself states added") does not say whether a later prospectus reprinting the same balance sheet governs; the analyst took the prospectus and showed the 20-F-only figure beside; (3) specific (b) covers a declining series, not a base negative throughout, whose perpetuity has no economic meaning; a line reporting "no positive price" in place of a magnitude would help; (4) the template asks for eight to ten balance sheets and says nothing where only five exist; (5) Q1 test 11 does not say whether a dual-class structure giving one person nearly all the vote is read at Q1 or left to Q5 and Q6. The analyst could not get balance sheets before March 2022, an SEC-filed competitor, or whether Hainan Lianhe still holds its 30% stake (omitted from the 20-F's beneficial-ownership table).
runs.narr: Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE): a small PRC machine-vision and robotics integrator in a field its own 20-F calls one of rapid iteration with no significant barriers to entry; revenue mix, software margin, top customers and top suppliers all turned over in five filed years, and new robot and car-service lines were added, so the ten-year economics cannot be foreseen. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: owner cash negative in four of five years, a value of -$10.61 a share against $0.47, no positive price earning the floor; fair -$1.92 all-equity (-$2.27 equity-only), not armed. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: Class B sold to the chief executive's company at $0.165 while the company's own filing put the bid at $1.00 or more, $1.37M owed by the chief executive, $12.2M of prepaid R&D fees against ten R&D staff, the auditor replaced two weeks before the year end, a going-concern note.
